answer_text:
A good place to order depends mostly on **where you need it delivered (country)**, **your budget**, and whether you want **easy gifting (gift wrap + message + fast shipping)**. Here are reliable options by scenario:

## Best all‑around (wide selection + dependable delivery)
- **Sephora** (US/Canada/parts of Europe): huge range, easy gift sets, gift messages, quick shipping in many areas.
- **Ulta Beauty** (US): lots of gift sets + drugstore-to-prestige options.

## “Nice gift” beauty retailers (more curated)
- **Dermstore** (US): skincare-focused, great for dermatologist brands and sets.
- **Space NK** (US/UK): premium skincare/makeup, excellent gift edits.
- **Cult Beauty** (UK/EU, some international): trend-forward, strong gift sets.

## Luxury department stores (best presentation)
- **Nordstrom** (US): strong packaging, easy returns, solid selection.
- **Selfridges / Harrods** (UK + international): luxury brands and impressive gifting.
- **Bloomingdale’s / Saks / Neiman Marcus** (US): upscale gifts, often good gift wrap.

## If you want “send directly from the brand”
Great when you know the recipient’s favorite brand:
- **Glossier, Rare Beauty, Fenty Beauty, Dior/Chanel beauty, La Mer, Drunk Elephant, Tatcha**, etc.  
Brand sites often have exclusive sets and nicer unboxing.

## If you want something personal
- **Etsy**: custom makeup bags, skincare gift boxes, personalized items—choose sellers with lots of recent reviews and clear delivery timelines.

---

### Quick picks (if you just want the safest choice)
- **US:** Sephora or Nordstrom  
- **UK:** Space NK or Selfridges  
- **EU:** Sephora (where available) or Cult Beauty  
- **Canada:** Sephora

If you tell me **the delivery country/zip**, **budget**, and whether it’s **skincare, makeup, fragrance, or “no idea”**, I can recommend 3–5 specific gift sets that ship there.
